title: Webinar video and slides available
summary: Slides and video are now available from our Sept. 23, 2021 webinar describing the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
bodyHtml: Did you miss last week's webinar describing the exciting changes to the former Diabetes Epigenome Atlas, now known as the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA; cmdga.org)? You can catch up with this video recording of the session, and also download the slides.
